Referral Assistant

A short guide for the chat. Four jobs. Type a number. Tap send.

Open the chat

Type the referrer phone number. Use the same number every time. Example: 012-345 6789.

The chat says hello and shows this menu:

1Add Lead

Use this when you have a new person to refer.

  1. Type 1 and send.
  2. Type the lead name and phone.
  3. Area is optional.
  4. Pick an agent, or leave “No preference”.
  5. Remarks are optional.
  6. Tap Submit lead.

2Edit Lead

Use this to change a lead you already sent.

  1. Type 2 and send.
  2. Type the lead number. Example: 1.
  3. Type the number of the thing you want to change.
  4. Type the new value and send.

3Check Lead

Use this to see your leads. You only look. You do not edit here.

  1. Type 3 and send.
  2. Read the list: name, phone, area, agent, and status.

4My Details

Use this for your payout details. The office needs these to pay you.

  1. Type 4 and send.
  2. Fill your name, bank, account, IC, TIN, and address.
  3. Your phone is shown. You cannot type a new phone here.
  4. Tap Save details.
If you get stuck
  • Type menu to see the 4 choices again.
  • Type cancel or 0 to leave a form.
  • Tap Switch number to log in with another phone.
